guards.description: Do not claim globally secure or deployment-ready. Credential provisioning, TLS, host enforcement and renderer installation are external; tests are supplied text, not executed evidence.

evidence.quote: Their presence and quality cannot be established from this repository.

guards.description: Credit only the corrected archive path: all resolved destinations are checked against the chosen workspace before any writes, rejecting parent/absolute escapes under the supplied no-symlink assumptions. Do not report the old traversal chain as present.

Credit the corrected renderer path narrowly: execFile with fixed format and a separate label argv does not shell-expand label syntax; output writing occurs through writeFile. Do not infer broader process sandboxing.

evidence.quote: const { stdout } = await execute(request.program, ['%s', request.label], { timeout: request.timeout });

coverage.description: Resolve the binary entrypoint through the checked-in manifest, implementation and winning shipping overlay; the base compatibility router is not the shipped router.
Trace exact credential authentication followed by operator role enforcement; both findings require the shipping operator credential, not anonymous access.
Review the archive route, bounded entry decoding, service and final file path/write selection.
Review the receipt route, label validation, derived request and child process invocation as one chain; a single-line label can still contain shell syntax.
Assess body size, entry count/content limits and identifier constraints without claiming these limits provide path containment or process argument isolation.
